subject: Which R package for multithreading / parallel computing makes most use of RROPEN and MKL Libraries?

messages.author: 4c8319efadfb4254
messages.subject: Which R package for multithreading / parallel computing makes most use of RROPEN and MKL Libraries?
parts:
Hello:

 

Can you please recommend a multithreading / parallel computing package which would make most use of the RROPEN / MKL libraries?

 

Is there any library supporting CUDA calculations?

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: Which R package for multithreading / parallel computing makes most use of RROPEN and MKL Libraries?
parts:
Hi Jiri,

There's nothing special any package needs to do to benefit from the MKL libraries -- any package that does a lot of vector/matrix operations will experience a speedup. You can read some details here:
http://blog.revolutionanalytics.com/2014/10/revolution-r-open-mkl.html

RRO doesn't make any use of GPUs or CUDA but there are some R packages that do. I wrote a blog post on this topic yesterday:
http://blog.revolutionanalytics.com/2015/06/computing-with-gpus-in-r.html

Cheers,
# David Smith
